Mission for a Merchant
I have heard rumors of a group of Mabrigash in Baan Binif who have been causing trouble for travelers. I should be wary when traveling near there.

I met a merchant named Llars Verano, who has had trouble with a group of Mabrigash. He has asked me to retrieve his stolen sword. I have accepted his request. I must now go into Baan Binif and find the Mabrigash.
I met a merchant named Llars Verano, who has had trouble with a group of Mabrigash. He has asked me to help retrieve his stolen sword. I denied his request.
I have spoken to the head of the mabrigash who told me that she had an alternate proposal for me: get rid of Llars Verano, and I may have some of their riches.
I found the Mabrigash and they proved to be hostile when I insisted that they hand over the sword. I had to kill them all.
Llars Verano wouldn’t leave without his sword, so I had to kill him. I should return to the head of the Mabrigash and report my success.
I was able to convince Llars Verano to leave. I should return to the head of the Mabrigash and report my success.
I returned to head of the Mabrigash and reported my success, but they betrayed me. They attacked me and I had to defend myself.
I returned to head of the Mabrigash and reported my success. She was true to her word and rewarded me with a considerable amount of gold.

I returned to head of the Mabrigash and reported my success. She offered me gold, but I preferred the sword. She wouldn’t part with it and was offended that I rejected her initial offer. She and her friends attacked me and I had to defend myself.
I have returned the stolen sword to Llars Verano. He thanked me and rewarded me with a considerable amount of gold.
I returned to Llars Verano and told him that I got rid of the Mabrigash, but I decided to keep the sword for myself. He wasn’t happy.

I met a traveling merchant named Llars Verano. He had a valuable sword that was stolen from him by a group of Mabrigash. Fortunately, I had already gotten a hold of the sword and was able to give it back to him.

I met a traveling merchant named Llars Verano. He had a valuable sword that was stolen from him by a group of Mabrigash. I had already obtained that sword and decided to keep it for myself. Verano was not happy.
The Mystery of the Ghost Snake

I have come across a mabrigash named Kausha Mantashpi on a small island to the west of Tel Aruhn. She told me that even though I'm an outlander, I'm a Dunmer woman, who was adopted by the Ashlanders. I have appeared in a vision to her, therefore, I am given the opportunity to be initiated into the cult of the Ghost Snake. It is up to me whether I would accept this opportunity or not.

I have accepted the opportunity to be initiated into the cult of the Ghost Snake. As my trial, I should find this tribe of Mabrigash a replacement for the male they have killed. She insisted that this male should be a Dunmer, and warned me that this male should be someone insignificant, they don't want me to kidnap a Hlaalu noble and risk a band of mercenaries wiping out their camp. Perhaps I should ask around in the nearby settlements.
I have bought a male Dunmer slave from Savile Imayn. He will be escorted to the camp of the Mabrigash in a day.
The male slave should have been delivered to the camp of the mabrigash by now.

Kausha Mantashpi was grateful for the slave, and taught me how to cast one of the less powerful magical spells associated with the Ghost Snake. She also offered me to share what she knew about the Ghost Snake and the Mabrigash.
I have declined the opportunity to be initiated into the cult of the Ghost Snake.
Lost Boy
I have heard rumors that Drelyn Uvaren has gone missing. His sister, Maren Uvaren is offering a reward for any information on his whereabouts.

I have spoken to Maren Uvaren about her missing brother, who offered me any information I could find about Drelyn Uvaren’s whereabouts. She mentioned that he was last seen near Baan Binif, a large hive structure near Valenvaryon.
I have found Drelyn's body. He died in Baan Binif. I should report back to Maren Uvaren.

I have told Maren Uvaren what happened to her brother. She was saddened with her loss, but took comfort in knowing what had happened to him. She rewarded me with a special amulet that can summon a powerful atronach.

My brother, Drelyn Uvaren, has been missing for some time now. I am paying for any information on his whereabouts and reason for disappearing. The only information I have on him is that he was last seen near Baan Binif, a large empty hive in the Ashlands, near the old Dunmer stronghold of Valenvaryon. If you have any more information for me, I will happily pay.
Very well, this is yours.

For your kindness in helping me, I have decided to give you an amulet of your choosing. I had made these for my brother, in case he ever returned, but I believe he would want you to have one. So, %PCName, what element best suits you? Fire? Frost? Or, perhaps, Shock?

This is his handwriting...I can't believe he's gone.Thank you, %PCName, I now know where he is. I will send a group of guards to bring back his body so he may have a proper burial. Please, take this for your kindness."
Then bring me something! I refuse to believe he died like that, killed by some spiders. You think you can just fool me and get your reward?
But he was a skilled sorcerer! How did he die like that?!? Wait, do you have anything to prove what you're telling me?
You should get going then.
Yes, I am still paying for any information on my brother. Why? Do you have any information to report?
How dare you reject my generous offer? I should teach you a lesson!
Here you go.
Astounding. You actually came through for us. Fine. Take this gold.
Did you get rid of the merchant?
Astounding. Well, I should give you your reward then.
Did you get rid of that merchant?
That's too bad. I must teach you a lesson then!
Fantastic. See you soon.

Funny. Very funny. How about a counter proposal? Robbing the merchant and watching him squirm was fun for a while, but now he is getting annoying. He just won’t leave! Get rid of him for us and we will share our riches with you!
A stolen sword, you say?
I will teach you a lesson!

Hahaha, little man ... how about a counter proposal? Robbing the merchant and watching him squirm was fun for a while, but now he is getting annoying. He just won’t leave! Get rid of him for us and we will share our riches with you! Otherwise we shall have to let our frustrations out ... on you.

Kogoruhn used to lie north of the northern boundary of the Ghostfence. It was northeast of Maar Gan and west of the present-day Vos. It was near Baan Binif and the stronghold of Falasmaryon, which I can mark on your map.

Have you seen that massive, dark, weird structure in the middle of the ashlands? It’s called Baan Binif. People have been known to disappear there. Should you get caught in the middle of an ashstom, it’s safer to find shelter inside a tomb than in that thing!

East of the camp, along the coast, there’s an ancient structure known as Baan Binif. Due to its particular shape, it’s easy to recognize and it can help you find your way should you get lost in the ashlands. There’s a big tree inside that some of us consider sacred. It’s considered good custom to leave a gift to the tree, should you happen to pass by.

Drelyn Uvaren went missing some time ago. His sister, the enchantress Maren Uvaren, has put a bounty out for any information on his whereabouts. If you’re looking for work, you might try talking to her.
Someone in Tel Aruhn has put a bounty out for a missing person. Might be worth asking around there for more information.

Most of us, Mabrigash, are former Wise Women, or apprentices of Wise Women. As I have mentioned, a Wise Woman is a seer. We get visions from the gods and the ancestors. It is these visions sent by the Ghost Snake, which gives us the power to break away from our oppressive tribes and forge our own destinies, separately from them. This is all I can tell you, initiate. You were chosen by the Ghost Snake, for your destiny is to do a deed which would change the history of this entire nation forever.

We have an understanding of the magic of the Ghost Snake, which allows us to charm males and steal their power for ourselves. It is nothing like the pathetic magic you might have come across in your Westerner guilds. Who is the Ghost Snake? I cannot tell you the whole truth, for that is reserved for more powerful Mabrigash, and not mere initiates. Let's just say a spirit, whose powers only women can utilize and understand. Someone who makes males weak and servile - the way they want women to be.

In such tribes, the Wise Woman is merely a ceremonial role, who no longer has any authoritiy in the tribe. As a result, the status of all women in the tribe decrease. They are abused, and held almost like slaves by the war-loving, greedy Ashkhan and his male followers. They are beaten, humiliated, and violated. This is the environment which gives way to the Mabrigash to be born. We have abandoned our tribes to live freely. We wield the war axe, which is normally preserved for the male Gulakhans.

On the other hand, males cannot become Wise Women. In case you don't know, a Wise Woman is a healer, seer, and the one responsible for preserving the knowledge and the stories of the tribe. A very important role, almost as important as the Ashkhan, who is normally a male. The Wise Woman is held in great respect by the members of the tribe. However, among the tribes that prefer war over peace, and are bloodthirsty, (such as the Erabenimsun Tribe) this balance between Ashkhan and Wise Woman is gone.

This is my understanding of the Ghost Snake and the history of the Mabrigash. The Ashlands are a rough place. Food is scarce, we live in danger because of the blight, and because of our conflicts with other Ashlander tribes and the settled people, the only way we can survive is by doing what our ancestors have done: after all, it worked for them, and we are still here. This means a strict hierarchy, and strict gender norms. In Ashlander society, women cannot become warriors or Gulakhans.

Ah ah ah! You killed the witch! You changed your mind on these people uh? Now that she's dead, why don't you find the key to these bracers and let me go free? Come on! You put me in this situation, it's the least you can do!

[The male slave looks around with caution, before he whispers to you.] So you were the one who is responsible for my captivity here? I swear to you, one day I'm going to kill all of them in their sleep and then I'll follow you to Oblivion if I must, and kill you too.
Welcome back, sister.

Our new slave has arrived. His vital essences will help us to unravel the mysteries of the Ghost Snake. As promised, I'll initiate you into the Cult of the Ghost Snake. What this means in practical terms is that I will teach you a spell to steal the vital essences of men. [She explains how to cast the spell.] It is a weaker spell, real Mabrigash have access to more powerful variants, but it is still a great honor for you. I will also share my knowledge about the Ghost Snake and my people with you. Ask.

Very well. The initiation of every mabrigash should begin by demonstrating that she disregards male life. As you may have noticed, our latest slave has been killed outside. I want you to find us a replacement. A Dunmer would be ideal. The stronger, more beautiful, more agile the Dunmer male slave, the better. However, I do not want you to kidnap a Hlaalu noble and risk a band of mercenaries coming here to retaliate. Find someone who wouldn't be missed. Someone without connections, and significance.

It concludes our business then. Even though the Ghost Snake has chosen you for this honor, you are a fool for denying this opportunity. It suits me fine, because you're an outlander, ignorant of our ways, and I was never too fond of doing this anyway. Now go.

You are an outlander, so normally, I wouldn't talk with you. However, you have appeared in a vision for me, as one chosen by the Ghost Snake for a great task. I do not like it, but I'm not going to question the Ghost Snake's will. At least you are a Dunmer woman, who has some standing among the Ashlanders. You are to be initiated into the Cult of the Ghost Snake, and her mysteries will be shared with you. What do you say?
Thank you for helping me with the matter of my missing brother, %PCName. Now, how may I be of service?
Hello %PCRace, how might I be of service? Are you looking to buy or sell, or are you here about my missing brother?
So, is the mean little merchant still asking for a stolen sword?
Then get to it.
Have you done what I asked for?
What do you want, little one? What are you rambling on about a stolen sword?
What do you want, insect? What are you rambling on about a stolen sword?
Yes, yes, I will leave.
Fine, I will leave. What a shame, though. That sword would have made me rich.
Fine ...
What? No, please. I am ruined if I leave without my sword!
What? I told you I cannot leave without my sword.
Ah, you have returned. Do you have my sword?
I will be on my way soon. I just need to rest a little.
Just my luck. Be robbed twice in a day.
Thank you! Here is your reward, as promised.
If you wouldn't mind to hurry a bit?
I guess I'm on my own then.
Do you have my sword?
Just my luck. Being robbed twice in a day.
Thank you! Here is a little reward for you.
Yes ... yes, that is my sword! Please, hand it over!

I want to leave, but I can’t without my sword. A wealthy buyer in Ald’ruhn is willing to pay a fortune for it. I must have it back, but I am no fighter. Say, would you be interested to help me out? If you manage to bring back my sword, I will give you a share of my future earnings.

Why have you come to this wretched place, stranger? I am only here because I was caught in an ash storm and lost all direction. Then I was ambushed by these Mabrigash. They robbed me and ran into this weird structure. I don’t know what it is, but I find it ... disturbing.
Too bad. I would have made it worth your while.
Excellent! As I said, they went in there. It’s a large place, so you might have to look around a bit. I’ll be waiting for you right here.
%Name cannot help.
They have all been bought by others, and waiting for delivery. Try Tel Aruhn.
Come back when you have the money and don't waste my time.
A pleasure doing business with you. I'll have your new slave escorted to this place that you have chosen. Expect him to be delivered in a day.
Then why exactly are you wasting my time?

So, you're telling me that you need a male Dunmer slave to be sent to some sort of camp inside Baan Binif? It can be arranged, but for no less than 2000 gold. I can offer you a relatively well-bred male Dunmer. He is an impoverished noble, disowned by his family, who became a slave because of his debts to the Camonna Tong. Do you want to buy him? The price includes my mercenaries escorting him to this place you have chosen, so you don't need to worry about that.
I don't know where you could find one. Not here, that's certain.
Jobasha cannot offer any help with that. Could Jobasha interest you in a fine book instead?
Keep walking. You are not welcome in my home if you keep asking such questions from me.
I'm not going to help you with that.
Preposterous! How dare you ask something like that from me?
Everyone knows that the best place to acquire any slave is the Slave Market of Tel Aruhn. Maybe you should inquire there?
The male slave has proven to be useful for our purposes so far.
Yes, you must bring us a male slave. What is so hard to understand about that?
What are you talking about?
We respect it as a sacred site. Have you seen the tree? You think something so beautiful and majestic could exist here, in the middle of the ashlands? No, it has to be a blessed place.
This is Baan Binif. Walk with respect, %PCRace.
Yes, we’re inside of it. What else do you want to know?

People think it's a cursed place, and we let them believe that. For us, it’s a sacred place. It helps us navigate the ashlands, offers protection during an ashstom, and leaving a gift to the big tree brings good luck.
People say it’s better to stay away from it. You should follow that advice
I can’t tell you much about it. A scout who knows his way around the Ashlands might be able to tell you more.
They say it’s a dangerous place, and that’s all I know about it.

It’s a mysterious place. People say it’s dangerous, but I’m not sure how much truth there’s to that. It’s hard to miss given how unearthly it looks. It’s located east of Valenvaryon. Here, let me mark it on your map.

That’s Baan Binif. At that point turn south and you’ll reach Kogoruhn, a great table of stone with many ruined buildings. There are many rooms. The passages are old and deep. Beneath are caves with pools of fire. It is a bad place. Go prepared.

Kogoruhn was an ancient Dunmer stronghold. Here. Let me mark it on your map. Go by day, in good weather, or you may miss your way. Follow the coast east from Urshilaku camp to the ruined Dunmer stronghold called Valenvaryon, then turn southwest. You'll see Ebernanit, a ruined Daedric shrine. Go past Ebernanit until you see a massive black structure.
I've had enough of you! Give me the key!
Very nice! Thank you, I feel so much better already! Now that I don't have those damn bracers on, I think it's time to have my revenge!
Come on, let me go! Unlock these bracers!
Come on, let me go!
It is an ancient Dwemer ruin to the north of here and south east of Baan Binif. Leave this place, find the ruins, and return Spell Breaker to me.
